name: Stares Back
source:
Looking for relief, signs point her towards a mysterious nebula. Now she needs a closer look.

[From [url=https://stephenw313.itch.io/stares-back]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
苦苦寻觅心灵慰藉的她，顺着种种征兆将目光投向了一片神秘的星云。如今，她决定凑近细看个究竟。
